title: Best Gaming Monitor 32 Inch (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products were chosen from the provided sources, prioritizing those mentioned by multiple sites. The LG 32GS95UE-B appears in PCMag and Eurogamer, while the Asus PG32UCDM and Samsung Odyssey G7 are highlighted in Reviewed and Eurogamer. Dell S3222DGM and GameOn GOP32FHD240VA are included for breadth.
assumptions: Prices are not listed in the sources, so no cost comparison is made.

verdict.line: Picture a pro gamer who needs both 4K detail and 480Hz frame rates; the LG 32GS95UE-B lets you switch between 4K/240Hz and 1080p/480Hz with a single button. It delivers OLED brightness and a thin bezel for immersive play. The catch: it lacks USB‑C and KVM support.
